{{Quote|She's reached the ''ore conveyer...!'' It'll carry her out of the ''chamber''!|Stormtrooper|<ref name="MSW30">[[Star Wars (1977) 30|''Star Wars'' (1977) 30]]</ref>}}
A '''cargo crawler''' was a non-[[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle used for the transportation of heavy equipment, such as [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]], to or around the battlefield. [[Rusher's Brigade]] used cargo crawlers at the [[Battle of Gazzari]] to move artillery, although [[Beadle Lubboon]] also used one to drag a makeshift stretcher carrying [[Ryland Dackett]] to safety.
